:::{#def-loocv}
#### Leave-one-out cross-validation

**Leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV)**
is [$\nfolds$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold) with $\nfolds = \nobs$,
so that each of the $\nobs$ [folds](#def-folds) holds one observation,
and the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) $\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\cdot}$
of observation $\iobs$'s [fold](#def-fold-assignment)
is fitted to all observations except observation $\iobs$.
Its [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) (@eq-cv-estimate with $\nfolds = \nobs$) is

$$
\cvest{\nobs} = \frac{1}{\nobs} \sum_{\iobs \in \obsidx} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{\iobs}}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-loocv}

Source: @james2021islr2e [sec.\ 5.1.2];
@wikipedia_cross_validation_statistics.
:::
